newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Southeast won't meet Q4 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Southeast won't meet Q4 forecast.

text.p: ASA Holdings Inc, parent of Atlantic Southeast Airlines. said on Monday it will not meet analysts' earnings expectations for the fourth quarter because of higher expenses related to fuel and maintenance.
Analysts had a consensus fourth quarter earnings estimate of $0.45 a share, according to First Call.
The company's revenues and December traffic were hurt by inclement weather, ASA said.

ASA Holdings declined to comment further on its earnings outlook. The company reported earnings per share of $0.35 in last year's fourth quarter. Also, the company said it authorized the purchase of up to $50 million of its stock in 1997. The shares will be used for general corporate purposes.

Atlantic Southeast's December load factor increased to 47.0 percent from 45.2 percent in December 1995, ASA said. Revenue passenger miles increased to 65.6 million in December from 63.7 million in the year ago period, ASA said.
December's available seat miles fell to 139.5 million from 140.8 million in December 1995, ASA said.
